new_results.statement: If two physical diagonal entries have opposite signs and magnitudes at least m>0 under the full three-large-eigenvalue target, then ||p_Q||_infinity <=50 m^(-3/4).
For every fixed 0<=tau<1/3, if s2(A-diag A)<=tau then ||p_Q||_infinity <=max(50(1-tau)^(-3/4), pi/sqrt((1-tau)^2-4tau^2)). In particular tau=3/10 gives ||p_Q||_infinity<66.
